Requested Evidence: Current cardholder-data flow diagram, CDE/network diagrams, inventory of in-scope and connected/impacting systems, payment channel description
Validation Focus: Confirm all payment flows, scope boundaries, connections and system components; reconcile diagram with actual environment.

Requested Evidence: Service-provider inventory, responsibility matrix, contracts and relevant current PCI DSS compliance evidence with service scope
Validation Focus: Confirm provider identity, services, period, scope and merchant responsibilities; do not assume outsourcing removes scope.

Requested Evidence: Network security control standards, current rules/configurations, change approvals and periodic rule review records
Validation Focus: Compare rules to approved business flows; inspect owner, justification, review and removal of obsolete rules.

Requested Evidence: System inventory, secure configuration standards, baseline compliance evidence and default-setting management records
Validation Focus: Sample components and compare actual configurations to approved baselines.

Requested Evidence: Data discovery and storage inventory, retention/deletion policy, key management records and approved redacted evidence
Validation Focus: Determine whether account data is stored and whether storage, retention and protection meet applicable requirements; do not request live PAN.

Requested Evidence: Approved TLS/cryptography standard, endpoint and certificate inventory, configuration and scan evidence
Validation Focus: Check in-scope transmission paths and cryptographic configuration against current requirements.

Requested Evidence: In-scope asset inventory, malware protection coverage, update status, detection alerts and response tickets
Validation Focus: Reconcile asset coverage and inspect update/alert handling evidence.

Requested Evidence: Patch/vulnerability reports, secure development lifecycle documents, code-review evidence, change tickets and release approvals
Validation Focus: Trace sampled vulnerabilities and software changes through approval, remediation and verification.

Requested Evidence: Access matrix, role definitions, approved access requests, periodic access review and termination records
Validation Focus: Check need-to-know, least privilege, access approval and timely removal.

Requested Evidence: Unique account inventory, authentication and MFA configuration, identity lifecycle records, privileged access review
Validation Focus: Test applicable authentication requirements and identify shared, orphaned or inadequately protected accounts.

Requested Evidence: Physical security policy, visitor/access logs, badge reviews and media controls for applicable locations
Validation Focus: Confirm physical scope and inspect access authorization and review evidence.

Requested Evidence: Log source inventory, logging configuration, time synchronization, access restrictions, review records and alert tickets
Validation Focus: Trace event coverage, protection, review and response for in-scope components.

Requested Evidence: Vulnerability scan and penetration test scope/results, segmentation test evidence where applicable, remediation and retest records
Validation Focus: Check scope, applicable timing, findings, tester independence/qualification where required and retest closure.

Requested Evidence: Approved security policies, risk assessment, awareness records, incident response tests, service-provider monitoring and governance records
Validation Focus: Check approval, review, implementation, ownership and relevant requirement-level coverage.

Requested Evidence: Remediation tickets, approved exceptions, retest results, residual-risk decisions and management sign-off
Validation Focus: Verify traceability from requirement to gap, fix, retest and authorized closure.
